page_title: ROM 1-1 JUV | AS Roma v Juventus 05/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' A precise cross towards the edge of the box was latched onto by Evan Ndicka (AS Roma). He outjumped the defence and produced a powerful header which went a whisker wide of the right post.
90+4' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
90+4' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) gets inside the box and tries to beat Wojciech Szczesny with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
90+1' Angelino (AS Roma) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
88' Filip Kostic (Juventus) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

88' A header by Moise Kean (Juventus) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Mile Svilar, who makes a brilliant save. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
87' There's an opportunity for Filip Kostic (Juventus) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
87' Weston McKennie (Juventus) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick.
86' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Edoardo Bove, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
85' Substitution. Andrea Cambiaso will be replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Juventus).
84' Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
82' A cross into the box from Filip Kostic (Juventus) is cleared.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.

80' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Mile Svilar stops the ball from going inside the top right corner. The ball is out of play. Juventus will have a chance to score from a corner.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Edoardo Bove (AS Roma) comes onto the pitch so that Lorenzo Pellegrini can be given a rest.
78' Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
77' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the free kick which is dealt with by the opposition defence.
77' A player from Juventus brings down an opponent and commits a foul.
76' Massimiliano Allegri has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Moise Kean (Juventus) replacing Federico Chiesa.
76' Substitution. Dusan Vlahovic makes his way off the pitch and Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) comes on as his replacement.
76' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
75' The resulting corner, taken by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), comes to nothing.

75' Angelino (AS Roma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
74' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
74' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. The referee points to the corner flag and AS Roma will take a corner.
72' Angelino (AS Roma) delivers a fine ball into the box from a free kick. However, the opposition's defence make sure none of his teammates get a challenge in on the goalkeeper.
71' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) for his blatant foul.
71' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is easily saved by Mile Svilar.
69' AS Roma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

69' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Wojciech Szczesny makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! AS Roma win a corner.
69' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
68' Here is a change. Tommaso Baldanzi is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma).
68' Substitution. Tammy Abraham (AS Roma) replaces Romelu Lukaku.

67' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. AS Roma win a corner kick.
67' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Mile Svilar.
66' Federico Gatti (Juventus) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
65' A pass by Federico Chiesa (Juventus) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
63' Danilo (Juventus) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header directed towards the goal is brilliantly saved by the goalkeeper.
63' Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.

62' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Mile Svilar has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
61' The substitution is prepared. Filip Kostic (Juventus) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Timothy Weah.
59' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
58' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for AS Roma.
57' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. AS Roma force their opponents to concede a corner.
56' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
55' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
55' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) trips an opposition player and Andrea Colombo signals a foul.
53' Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) tries to find Weston McKennie, but he puts too much power on the pass.
52' Angelino (AS Roma) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

50' Wasted effort! Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
50' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
49' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
48' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Timothy Weah.
47' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) throws the chance away as he attempts to produce a shot from inside the box. His attempt simply rattles the right post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
46' A substitution has been made. Paulo Dybala goes off and Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) comes on.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' Andrea Colombo has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) attempts to put in the resulting set piece, but he miskicks and sends the ball into the stands. A strong but inaccurate shot. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
44' One of the Juventus players tripped an opponent and conceded a foul. It's a free kick to AS Roma in a dangerous position.
43' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
43' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) will take a corner kick.
43' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. AS Roma get a corner.
42' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar.

41' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) missed a great opportunity! He finds himself some space near the penalty spot and plants a header goalwards which lacks both power and accuracy. The ball sails well over the bar! The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
41' Weston McKennie (Juventus) plays the ball to Manuel Locatelli with a cheeky pass and their attacking move continues.
40' Angelino (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
38' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) failed to convert a mid-range free kick and sends the ball narrowly over the bar.
36' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. AS Roma have a free kick.
36' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
33' One of the players from Juventus times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

31' 1 - 1 Goal! Federico Chiesa plays a neat lofted pass into the box for Bremer (Juventus), who beats the defender in the air and plants a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 1:1.
30' The corner kick from Federico Chiesa (Juventus) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

30' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Juventus.
28' AS Roma fail to score from a corner as Wojciech Szczesny (Juventus) leaps to collect the ball.

27' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender. AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
25' A clumsy foul by Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle. Juventus have a free kick.
24' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
24' Timothy Weah (Juventus) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.

23' Timothy Weah (Juventus) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort. The ball is behind the touchline and Juventus will take a throw-in.
23' Federico Gatti (Juventus) plays a terrific long ball forward to Timothy Weah, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down. It's a throw-in for Juventus.

19' Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
18' Half-chance! Adrien Rabiot (Juventus) plays a pass into the box, but Mile Svilar reacts well to snuff out the attack.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
14' Angelino (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

13' What a chance that is! Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes high over the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
12' Angelino (AS Roma) switches the play to Romelu Lukaku and their attacking move continues.
12' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Andrea Colombo signals. AS Roma have a free kick.
11' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the crossbar!
10' Angelino (AS Roma) plays very simply and looks confident today. He makes the game easier for his team with some brilliant lofted through balls.
6' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and AS Roma will have a goal kick.
4' What was Timothy Weah (Juventus) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
3' Federico Chiesa (Juventus) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
